narrative:
## Handover Summary — Revenue Planning

Revenue targets set for five business units, ten service lines and four UK regions, replacing the BU submission cycle previously run outside the data platform.

## Key Decisions
• UK Insurance London & South East raised 6% on Corporate PMI renewal pricing
• Dental Care North raised 6% on Bupa Smile Plan membership and insured patient volumes
• Clinics & Hospitals Midlands & East raised 6% on day-case and diagnostic demand
• Gap to GBP 3.85B ambition reduced from GBP 50M; remaining gap held as a stretch target

## Recommendation for Cost of Care
Plan claims cost against the higher member volumes and price medical inflation explicitly — the margin is more sensitive to claims inflation than to revenue growth.

signals.title: Bupa Global, India & UK revenue +11%, underlying profit +23%
signals.excerpt: Market unit revenue rose 11% to £3.1bn on customer growth and average premiums; underlying profit rose 23% to £154m.

signals.title: Revenue proposals accepted
signals.excerpt: Cluster proposals on UK Insurance, Dental Care and Clinics & Hospitals applied with full audit trail.
